calls.reason: The deadline is the end of 2027 and has not passed. The packet has no capex figures for 2026 or 2027.

Announced deals plus an unverified $200B Google report add up to about $718B. But no payment schedules or financing analysis show either lab can't pay, and Anthropic's $30B raise points the other way.

The commitment total roughly checks out, but the main claim does not. Reporting on shareholder documents gives OpenAI a 39% gross margin in Q1 2026 and $73B in cash, so it is not losing money on every sale or in urgent need of new capital.

The filings show profitable cloud segments (AWS, Google Cloud, Intelligent Cloud) but no profit figure for AI alone. OpenAI and Anthropic are not covered, and no AI-only profit is disclosed, so the claim can't be called either way.
Anthropic's S-1, as reported before the evaluation date, gives audited full-year 2025 revenue of $4.6B. That matches the $4.5B figure he called mathematically impossible and a lie.
No source confirms the 2.95GW figure for Google or how much of it Anthropic uses. The Google announcements only describe capacity coming online in 2026 and 2027.
